image_description: A dark, elongated aquatic animal swimming just below the surface of clear water. The water surface is rippled, creating significant distortion and reflection patterns (caustics) that obscure parts of the animal's body. The visible portion of the animal shows a dark grey/black back with some lighter mottling or reflections. No distinct head features like blowholes are clearly visible due to the angle and water distortion. The tail flukes are not clearly defined in this crop.
